title: Chapter 34: Building A New City
content:
Chapter 34: Building A New City

Wu Qing gained a lot. Although the assessment of the Talent Recruitment Hall increased the difficulty, he still selected nearly 100 available talents.

He simply rounded up the number and selected 100 people.

These people are different from the 20 people recruited last time. They are people with real talents in various industries and can share Wu Qing's worries.

For example, the 16 girls of the Flower Fairy Clan all swore to join the Great Xia Territory and passed the assessment of the Talent Recruitment Hall and became Wu Qing's direct subordinates.

These Flower Fairy Clan members are determined to leave the Tengu Clan.

Wu Qing learned from the information sent by the Queen of Insects that these 16 girls are all experts in plants.

They do not have the strength to enter the stars, but they can mobilize the energy of heaven and earth and affect plants by relying on their own talents.

"I picked up a treasure this time! With these Flower Fairy Clan members, I don't have to worry about farming in the future!"

Wu Qing decided to protect these Flower Fairy Clan members no matter what.

In addition to the Flower Fairy Clan members, there is also the Beaver Clan, who also brought a huge surprise to Wu Qing.

These beavers are all masters of construction, and the city construction of each territory cannot do without them.

The one who fled here this time is a lucky beaver family with a population of about 300 people. Their clan leader passed the assessment of the Talent Recruitment Hall.

These 300 beavers, except for those who cannot work, are all good at construction work.

These people are exactly what Wu Qing urgently needs.

The Zerg has no way to rebuild the city normally.

Everything of the Zerg is based on biotechnology, unless the Zerg mother nest is built in the middle of the city, and the entire city is built on the Zerg organic spread.

Even if people in this world can accept such an alternative city, Wu Qing does not want to expose it now.

In the Daxia Territory, the city on the surface is still developed and constructed in the way of this world.

Now with the addition of the beaver clan, the reconstruction of the territory city will be much simpler.

Others who passed the assessment are also good, enriching the talents of Daxia Territory in all aspects.

Wu Qing is very satisfied with this result.

…

Nearly 7,000 refugees were registered, and a day had passed.

According to statistics, there are 4,921 refugees who chose to join Daxia Territory this time. Together with the residents in the city, the total population of Daxia Territory now exceeds 7,000.

There are also nearly 2,000 refugees who, for various reasons, temporarily choose not to join Daxia Territory.

Wu Qing has set aside a separate area for these people, separating them from the people of Daxia Territory.

Starting tomorrow, all the food, clothing and daily necessities of these people must be obtained through their own labor.

They can choose their own jobs, but they can only choose from designated types of jobs.

These jobs are definitely not so easy to do, and the remuneration cannot be compared with that of the people of Daxia Territory.

Daxia Territory is so double-standard, who told you that you are not one of them?

Each of Wu Qing's 100 new subordinates received an identity card, and after binding, they all became interested in this magical card.

The talents from the big territories have different insights, and they can see the huge value of the identity card at once.

They saw the strength and potential of Daxia Territory from this small card, and were glad for their choice.

Dinner time has come, and everyone has a free simple meal provided by the city again.

At night, knowing the actions of the Zerg at night, most people were not disturbed tonight and fell asleep peacefully.

Although the environment is not good, at least the heart is at peace.

The place where the heart is at peace is home, and the home can be built with your own hands!

Wu Qing did not rest early tonight, but revised the design drawings of the new city of Daxia Territory with the Queen of Zerg. After the drawings are completed tonight, the city can be built tomorrow.

The city is still built according to the model that Wu Qing is familiar with, with the core area in the middle, which is not open to the outside world.

The outer ordinary urban area is for residents to live and work. In the future, if the city needs to be expanded, it can be built outward layer by layer, which is simple and convenient.

For the current core area, Wu Qing plans to reserve enough area first, and the location is set at a central point selected outside the current small city.

Mark out the core area for reservation, build a new city outside, and surround the core area in the middle.

Wu Qing planned to let the worker bees of the Zerg participate in the construction. The worker bees were good at digging holes and transporting. He planned to dig holes in the core area of the city and dig out another space underground.

The excavated soil and stone materials would be used for the construction of the new city, killing two birds with one stone.

Wu Qing's idea was to build the Zerg's buildings inside the underground space, so that the Zerg would have two hidden bases, which would increase safety and facilitate quick support to the Great Xia Territory.

This was the light and dark twin cities after the light and dark territories, one city on the ground and one city underground.

The new city also made a unified plan, demarcating residential areas, industrial areas, commercial areas, etc. Regardless of whether they are needed now, the location should be reserved first.

What needs to be built now is the residential area. The construction of the new city can be done step by step, so that everyone has a place to live first.

...

Early the next morning, a large number of Zerg worker bees arrived in the Great Xia Territory.

The worker bees came to the selected core area outside the city, directly destroyed the food that was still in the green seedling state, and began to dig.

There was no other way but to destroy part of the fields to build the city. The previous lord had not done a good job in city planning and did not reserve space for urban expansion.

It is impossible to feed the population of Daxia Territory with the fields outside the city. For the time being, we still have to get food from the wild.

There are strange things in the wild of this world. Without human intervention, the resources are extremely rich.

When the city development is on track, we will vigorously develop agriculture to ensure self-sufficiency in food.

The efficiency of the worker bees is very high. It didn't take long for them to dig a huge pit in the core area of the new city, and a large amount of soil and stones were transported out.

The official residents of Daxia Territory were assigned work tasks. The main task was to build the city, and the second was to ensure food supply.

The refugees who temporarily lived in Daxia Territory were also forced to participate in the construction of the city. If they didn't work, they would have nothing to eat.

Starting today, food is no longer provided for free.

The worker bees are responsible for heavy physical labor such as excavation and transportation. The beaver clan is responsible for the construction of the entire city under the guidance of the queen.

For others, the queen will assign corresponding work tasks according to the information registered by each person.

In this way, the worker bees dug the foundation, mined and transported stone and earth, and the beavers led the personnel to carry out meticulous work. Everyone cooperated and started the city construction in an orderly manner.

For the wood problem, Wu Qing asked the dog to go to the forest not far away to cut trees. He first felled the trees, and when needed, the worker bees could come to carry them.

The scope of the city construction this time even exceeded the current core area of lord protection. Wu Qing planned to make another adjustment later.

With so many people joining the Great Xia Territory, the people's hearts can be used, and the luck of the territory will naturally increase.

With the support of these lucks, the scope of the core area of lord protection can be expanded.

His principle is that if you don't do it, you should try to do it once.

As long as the new city is built according to the plan, with the area of the new city, it is more than enough to accommodate 100,000 people.

The construction of the new city officially began. As long as it goes according to plan, with the participation of the Zerg and the efforts of nearly 9,000 people, it won't be long before a brand new new city of the Great Xia Territory will stand here.
